protocol.selection: Per-position validation MAE for starts; validation 3-week rank correlation for acquisition. Test years never select weights.
limitations: Corrected retrospective data, not archived publication-time vintages
Missing future stat rows are censored, not assumed DNP zeroes
Acquisition targets are observed-game means within 1/3/4 calendar weeks; not exact historical league waiver pools
No historical injuries, current Sleeper ownership, or market data used
Model weights calibrated in PPR only; TE-premium evaluated without re-tuning
